text: Okay, like I literally just told you. There has to be a cheaper blue one with 20 hours battery life and water resistance. Like, come on. Is there really only one? Can you check again? I don't want to keep the expensive one.
zh: 好吧，我刚才刚跟你说。必须有一款更便宜的蓝色、20小时电池续航且防水的音箱。拜托，真的只有一款吗？你能再确认一下吗？我不想保留昂贵的那个。
